usage.notes: Use PMR primarily as an acquisition and provenance source. Pull only explicitly selected model exposures into a reviewed/versioned Panacea model cache; do not make core physiology features depend on a live PMR request or bulk-download the repository into the web bundle.

license.identifier: Repository-wide CC BY 3.0 statement plus model/exposure-specific license metadata
license.scope: PMR citation pages state that publicly accessible repository content is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0, but individual model/resource pages can also report their work-level terms as unspecified or provide a specific license. Panacea must therefore verify and persist the exact model/exposure/file license before production ingestion rather than assuming the repository-level statement resolves every uploaded resource or associated file.
license.notes: A model with missing/unspecified work-level rights is blocked from production asset/model ingestion until reviewed. Keep model code/data, figures, experimental data, simulation outputs and session files as separately licensable artifacts when their metadata differs. Always retain model authors and repository citation.

validation.notes: PMR contains curated and community models across many physiological domains. Repository availability, functional status, or curator comments do not make a model clinically validated. Panacea must separately verify original publication, model equations/units, numerical reproducibility, calibration/validation population and intended use before using output beyond education/research context.

provenance.authority: IUPS Physiome Project / Auckland Bioengineering Institute
provenance.notes: Persist exposure/workspace URL, changeset/revision, exact downloaded file names/checksums, model title, CellML authors, original paper/citation, retrieval date, curation/functional status, model-specific license and any COMBINE/SED-ML experiment metadata. Prefer immutable/versioned exposure identifiers over search-result titles.

adapter.notes: Planned flow: PMR search/curated allowlist -> exposure/revision selection -> license + citation + curation gate -> checksum acquisition -> CellML/SED-ML/COMBINE validation -> PanaceaPhysiologyModelSource -> CellML normalization -> simulation engine. A model is not automatically runnable or trusted merely because it exists in PMR; surface validation failures and unsupported constructs explicitly.

trust.notes: High-authority specialist model repository with strong revision/citation mechanisms. Evidence and license scores remain conservative because scientific validation and work-level license metadata vary by model/exposure.
